name: Client CRM Module
description: Comprehensive Customer Relationship Management system for photographers to maintain professional client databases, track preferences, link clients to galleries, manage communication history, and handle the complete client lifecycle from acquisition to retention with analytics and insights.
goals: Provide comprehensive client profile management with identity, contact, social media, and address information.
Enable gallery-client linking for personalized proofing workflows and selection tracking.
Track complete client activity timeline including gallery views, selections, favorites, and payments.
Maintain detailed communication history with follow-up reminders and scheduling.
Support client segmentation, smart lists, and bulk operations for efficient database management.
Provide client portal access for self-service gallery viewing and profile management.
Enable referral tracking and analytics for business growth insights.
Support avatar management with upload, crop, resize, and gallery photo selection.
Provide duplicate detection and merging capabilities for data quality.
Enable client preferences for auto-personalization of gallery experiences.
Support import/export for data migration and backup.
Provide comprehensive analytics dashboard with growth trends, engagement metrics, and revenue insights.
nonGoals: Full-featured enterprise CRM with sales pipeline and opportunity management (use dedicated CRM integrations).
Email marketing automation and campaign management (basic communication tracking only).
Advanced BI dashboards and predictive analytics (basic analytics and reporting only).
Accounting and bookkeeping features (integrate with payments module for invoicing).
Project management and task tracking (use separate project management tools).

rules: All client data is strictly workspace-scoped with mandatory workspace_id filtering.
Client queries MUST always include workspace_id in WHERE clause to prevent data leakage.
Gallery-client links are workspace-scoped and validated on both ends.
Client portal access is scoped to linked galleries within the same workspace.
Client tags, smart lists, and preferences are workspace-specific.
Client activities and communications are workspace-scoped.

fields.name: language

fields.name: internal_notes

fields.name: referred_by_client_id

entities.name: ClientContact

workflows.name: Create Client and Link to Gallery
steps: Photographer creates a new client profile with basic information (name, email, phone).
System validates data and creates client record with workspace_id.
Photographer links client to one or more galleries.
System creates client_gallery_links records.
System records activity in client_activities timeline.
Photographer optionally enables client portal access.
System creates portal user account and sends invitation email.

workflows.name: Client Proofing Workflow
steps: Client receives gallery share link via email/SMS.
Client views gallery and browses photos.
System records gallery_viewed activity.
Client makes selections and adds favorites.
System records selection_made and favorite_added activities.
Client adds comments on specific photos.
System records comment_added activity.
Photographer reviews client selections in CRM.
Photographer follows up with client via logged communication.

workflows.name: Communication Tracking and Follow-up
steps: Photographer logs communication (email, phone, WhatsApp) with client.
System creates client_communications record.
System records communication_sent activity.
Photographer sets follow-up reminder if needed.
System displays follow-up reminders on dashboard.
Photographer completes follow-up and logs outcome.
System updates communication history.

workflows.name: Referral Tracking
steps: New client mentions existing client as referral source.
Photographer creates new client and sets referred_by_client_id.
System links new client to referring client.
System increments referrals_count for referring client.
Photographer views referral analytics on dashboard.
Photographer optionally rewards referring client.

workflows.name: Smart List Segmentation
steps: Photographer creates smart list with filter criteria (tags, status, date range, gallery activity).
System evaluates criteria against all clients.
System dynamically updates list as clients match criteria.
Photographer performs bulk operations on smart list (add tags, send communications).
System applies operations to all clients in list.
System logs bulk operations in activity timeline.

workflows.name: Duplicate Detection and Merging
steps: Photographer creates new client.
System checks for potential duplicates based on email/phone.
System displays warning with matching clients.
Photographer reviews potential duplicates.
Photographer confirms duplicate and initiates merge.
System merges client records, preserving all gallery links, notes, and history.
System updates all references to point to merged client.
System archives duplicate client record.

controls: Workspace-scoped data isolation with mandatory workspace_id filtering on all queries.
Row-level security enforced at database level for multi-tenant isolation.
RBAC permissions for client data access (view, create, update, delete, export).
Sensitive data encryption at rest (internal_notes, communication notes).
Audit logging for all client data modifications and access.
Rate limiting on sensitive operations (export, import, merge, bulk operations).
Input validation and sanitization for all client data fields.
Email and phone verification to prevent spam and abuse.
Avatar upload size limits (5MB) and format validation (JPEG, PNG, WebP).
Duplicate detection to prevent data quality issues.
Client portal access requires explicit enablement by photographer.
Portal user accounts use separate authentication from staff users.
privacy: Client data is private to workspace members only.
Internal notes are never exposed to clients.
Client portal users can only view their own linked galleries.
Export operations are logged for compliance.
Data deletion is permanent and irreversible (with confirmation).
GDPR-compliant data export and deletion capabilities.
dataRetention: Deleted clients are permanently removed from database.
Gallery links are preserved when client is deleted (gallery data intact).
Activity timeline is preserved for audit purposes.
Communication history is preserved for legal compliance.
Archived clients retain all data but are hidden from active lists.

logs: Client CRUD operations with user_id and client_id.
Gallery link/unlink operations with gallery_id and client_id.
Activity timeline events with activity_type and metadata.
Communication logging with communication_type and direction.
Export operations with format and record count.
Duplicate detection results with confidence scores.
Merge operations with primary and duplicate client_ids.
Avatar upload operations with file size and format.
Bulk operations with affected client count.
Smart list evaluations with filter criteria and result count.
traces: Client list page load including DB queries, computed fields, and pagination.
Client detail page load including related data (contacts, addresses, tags, galleries, activities).
Client search operations including full-text search and filtering.
Gallery link operations including validation and activity recording.
Activity timeline queries with pagination and filtering.
Export operations including data serialization and file generation.
Import operations including parsing, validation, and bulk insert.
Merge operations including data consolidation and reference updates.
Smart list evaluation including dynamic filtering and sorting.
alerts: High client list query latency (>500ms P95).
High client search query latency (>300ms P95).
Abnormally high client creation rate (potential spam).
High duplicate detection rate (>20% of new clients).
High export operation frequency (potential data exfiltration).

indexing: Full-text search index on full_name for fast client search.
Composite indexes on (workspace_id, status, created_at) for filtered lists.
Composite indexes on (workspace_id, client_id) for all related tables.
GIN index on client_tags for tag-based filtering.
GIN index on filter_criteria for smart list evaluation.

acceptanceTests: Creating a client stores all profile information and generates unique client_id.
Linking a client to a gallery creates client_gallery_links record and records activity.
Client list displays avatars, names, primary contacts, and tags with pagination.
Client search returns results matching name, email, phone, or organization.
Activity timeline shows all interactions in reverse chronological order.
Communication logging creates client_communications record and activity.
Duplicate detection identifies potential duplicates based on email/phone.
Merging clients consolidates all data and updates references.
Smart lists dynamically update as clients match filter criteria.
Export generates CSV/JSON file with all client data.
Import validates data and creates client records, skipping duplicates.
Avatar upload generates optimized thumbnails and stores crop data.
Selecting gallery photo as avatar links to existing asset.
Client portal access creates user account and sends invitation.
Bulk operations apply changes to all selected clients.
Analytics dashboard displays growth trends, engagement metrics, and revenue insights.
Client deletion removes all data and unlinks galleries.
Workspace isolation prevents cross-workspace data access.

Do we need client consent management for GDPR compliance?
Should we support client self-registration through public forms?
Do we need client satisfaction surveys and NPS tracking?
Should we support client contracts and digital signatures?
Do we need client project/shoot management within CRM?
